name: c409_05_pin_ck_moved
covers: pin CAS, commit key moved: a peer's bulk marker lands between the pinning page's read of the commit key and its write; the pin reports a conflict and writes nothing

labels.A: begin BULK commit #1; A: BULK step 1:: a: open, bulk: the marker write (bulk-begin), held until p has read the commit key
labels.B: begin PIN of m/0; B: pin CAS -> 409;: p: open, pin: the pin's commit-key write, held until the marker is applied: pin:conflict
